description: Compare two of a preview's recorded renders. Defaults to the two newest — did the last publish move this preview? A metadata comparison: the timeline's versions are already collapsed distinct renders, so whether the bytes changed is answered without fetching either image. Reports `unstable` so a difference on a nondeterministic preview is not mistaken for a real change.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: catalog_history_diff
